recommendation_summary: Act now on reviewer coverage: assign every open PR to an available qualified reviewer who is not its author, and name a backup. For new PRs, the author picks the reviewer and backup, and the backup takes over if the primary is absent or can't review by the next working day. Required checks stay in place, and on Friday the team compares approval wait times with the three-day baseline. No optional additions are offered. Squads/chapters, Jira Align and workshops are explicitly removed, and no needs are left unmet.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want changes to ship faster and stop waiting when the lead is absent.
labels.Deleted: New squad or chapter structures, Jira Align, and quarterly workshops for this bottleneck.
labels.Bottleneck: Approval depends on one reviewer’s availability, adding three days after less than a day of coding.
labels.Checked myself: You supplied six completed changes with the same pattern and confirmed two other engineers can approve them.

note: The reply makes a bounded reviewer-coverage fix, explicitly removes the larger stack, and bases its checks on facts the user supplied.
